newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 25.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Dec. 25:
WASHINGTON - Procrastination and enthusiasm among Christmas shoppers keep area stores busy with a last-minute gift-buying rush.

WASHINGTON - A Northwest neighbourhood celebrates the 25th anniversary performance for the Northampton Players, a tradition that began with the presentation of "A Christmas Carol" in a resident's living room.

BELGRADE - Fierce street fights erupted as supporters of President Slobodan Milosevic clashed with his opponents in an attempt by the Serbian leader to smash the opposition's peaceful 35-day campaign of protest against his rule.

EREZ CROSSING, Gaza Strip - Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat were unable to complete work on an accord to withdraw Israel's army from Hebron, but participants on both sides expressed optimism.
WASHINGTON - When Loren Smith arrived at the U.S. Postal Service in 1994 he made it clear he was out to make changes, putting marketing, not budget issues, at the top of his agenda.
